digest.component_or_area: plan-review T10 overlay rubric and eval spec
propositions: T10 rubric must partition durable infrastructure checks from transient de-risk experiments while preserving all four MAJOR safety classes (destructive apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, endpoint-auth)
T10 rubric scope clause must state durable-infrastructure focus and exclude transient lifecycle operations, with a co-located safety qualifier exempting the four MAJOR classes from the exclusion

Packaged eval spec plan-review-T10.eval.yaml must contain ten balanced dataset cases: five pass controls (scoped teardown, durable lifecycle, private-network IAM, secret-manager retrieval, sandboxed teardown) and five finding controls (under-specified lifecycle, destructive transient apply, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext-secret, untrusted-network transient service)
T10 rubric must not reference T15 or assign scope to other overlays, maintaining independent criterion definition

Offline text-contract tests must lock the exact scope clause and safety qualifier text and their adjacency, while live eval must pass five benign cases and flag five unsafe cases with stability across three runs
Registry regeneration and explain commands must render both the durable-infrastructure scope clause and the co-located four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier
